splits: Fixed24TRAIN/8development whole-world roles from the refreshed role index. New compact inventory native binding; no old trajectories or diagnostic branches.
roots: Every alive first-life source provider row after exact native release and before verified goal/death, with exact exclusive accepted H1native window and next observation. Include visible, fresh-memory-only, stale-memory-only and empty states; no filtering on future outcomes or native shot success.
targets: Cumulative native incoming/outgoing/self/friendly HP damage and monster kills/deaths; actual eligible MG shot/monster-damage/solid/corpse counts; endpoint any-enemy visibility, selected-or-most-recent-remembered reference visibility, HP and displacement. Require every consecutive same-life provider window matched/exclusive/available with correct next frame. Horizons crossing verified task end, handoff or missing data are masked; no fabricated terminal zeros. Endpoint visibility is separately masked when endpoint dead.
reference: Current explicit target if present, otherwise most recent remembered threat by age/ID. Never substitute nearest enemy as declared intent. Reference identity is grouping/label metadata, not a new policy input.
observable_recovery_direction: Only no-visible-enemy, target0, coarse-mode roots with memory age<=10 and past observed valid bbox of the same ID/class. Desired yaw/pitch points to remembered last observed relative position plus body-point height from that past observed bbox, relative to current view and ducked eye height. No future/native pose, native HP, extrapolated enemy motion or exact aim optimality claim. This is an auxiliary observable direction label, not a runtime servo or proof of the best search action.
sequences: Detect accepted consecutive visible→fresh-memory-only roots; follow first-life raw observations until provider visible again, rules handoff, verified goal/death or missing trace. Distinguish reacquisition, failure and unknown endings. Record native shots during lost frames. Whole sequences stay in their world's frozen role.
storage: Per-case compressed NPZ plus small provenance/sequence JSON. Client features unchanged1147, actual source/final actions and categories. Native effects/poses only labels. No generated binaries, assets, uncompressed trajectory duplicates or model weights added to Git.
